questions.q: What does "Procure-to-Pay" refer to in Oracle Fusion Cloud?
options: A single screen inside the Payables work area
The end-to-end chain from requesting goods or services through to paying for them and posting the accounting
A report that lists overdue supplier invoices
A synonym for the chart of accounts
questions.explain: P2P spans requisition, purchase order, receipt, invoice, and payment/posting - it is a business process, not one screen.

questions.q: Put the five P2P stages in the correct order.
options: Invoice, requisition, receipt, purchase order, payment
Purchase order, requisition, invoice, receipt, payment
Requisition, purchase order, receipt, invoice, payment and posting
Payment, receipt, requisition, purchase order, invoice
questions.explain: The chain runs requisition, then purchase order, then receipt, then invoice, then payment and posting to the ledger.

questions.q: Why does this course deliberately follow one transaction across every module instead of teaching each module in isolation?
options: Because modules cannot be taught separately
Because requisitions and invoices use the same screen
Because Oracle Fusion only allows one transaction per company
Because a problem that surfaces in one stage, like Payables, is often caused by a decision made earlier, and no single role normally sees the whole chain
questions.explain: No single person normally sees the whole P2P chain, so tracing a downstream problem back to its upstream cause is a skill this course builds deliberately.

questions.q: What is the fictional item and supplier this course follows?
options: Industrial Pump Bearing, Model PB-4400, from Meridian Bearing Supply Co.
A laptop purchase from a supplier called Northwind Computers
Office chairs from a supplier called Vantage Office Supply
Raw steel coil from a supplier called Atlas Metals
questions.explain: The course follows LTV Manufacturing Corporation's purchase of Industrial Pump Bearing, Model PB-4400, from Meridian Bearing Supply Co.

questions.q: Why does this course use diagrams and plain description instead of software screenshots?
options: Screenshots are against Oracle's licensing terms
Diagrams render faster than images
The course author has never seen Oracle Fusion Cloud
Oracle Fusion Cloud is login-gated enterprise software with no public screenshots available, so none are fabricated or sourced from a real company's instance
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Cloud requires a login and has no public documentation screenshots, so this course relies on accurate description and diagrams rather than inventing or misusing screenshots.
